requirements.statement: A user signs in with their organization account before using the app

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is prompted to sign in via SSO before reaching the app
After a successful sign-in, the user lands in the app authenticated as themselves

requirements.statement: A user can create a named todo list

criteria.must: Submitting a new list with a name creates a list owned by the creator
The newly created list appears in the creator's list overview

requirements.statement: A list owner can rename or delete a todo list they own

criteria.must: The owner can rename their list and the new name is reflected in the overview
The owner can delete their list and it no longer appears anywhere
A non-owner collaborator cannot rename or delete the list

requirements.statement: A user can add a todo item with text and an optional due date to a list

criteria.must: Adding an item with text only creates an item with no due date
Adding an item with text and a due date creates an item carrying that due date

requirements.statement: A user can edit a todo item's text or due date

criteria.must: Editing an item's text updates the displayed text
Editing an item's due date updates the displayed due date

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo item as complete or incomplete

criteria.must: Marking an open item complete changes its status to complete
Marking a complete item incomplete reverts its status to open

requirements.statement: A user can delete a todo item

criteria.must: Deleting an item removes it from its list

requirements.statement: A user can view the todos in a list sorted by due date

criteria.must: Items in a list are displayed ordered by due date, earliest first
Items with no due date are displayed distinctly from items with a due date

requirements.statement: A user can see all their lists at a glance with a count of open items in each

criteria.must: The lists overview shows every list the user owns or collaborates on
Each list in the overview shows the count of its currently open (incomplete) items

requirements.statement: A list owner can share a list they own with another user

criteria.must: The owner can add another user as a collaborator on their list
The added collaborator gains access to view and edit the shared list's items
A non-owner collaborator cannot share the list with a further user

requirements.statement: A user can see who a shared list is shared with

criteria.must: The list's sharing view lists every current collaborator on that list

requirements.statement: A list owner can remove a collaborator from a list they own

criteria.must: The owner removing a collaborator revokes that collaborator's access to the list
A removed collaborator no longer sees the list in their overview

requirements.statement: A user sees lists shared with them by others alongside their own lists

criteria.must: The overview distinguishes lists the user owns from lists shared with them by another owner

requirements.statement: A collaborator can leave a list that was shared with them

criteria.must: A collaborator leaving a shared list removes it from their own overview
The list remains intact for its owner and any remaining collaborators after one collaborator leaves

requirements.statement: Only a list's owner may rename/delete the list or manage its collaborators; collaborators may manage items but not these

criteria.must: A collaborator attempting to remove another collaborator from the list is denied
A collaborator can still add, edit, complete, and delete items on the shared list despite these restrictions
